_comment: Feed Fork C routing registry — the map from 'what a doc is' to 'where it goes'. Data, not code. Rows walked top-down; first match(es) win; 'ledger' is ALWAYS appended by the router. Adding a route = adding a rule here. Later phase promotes this file to a Google Sheet.

rules._note: Consolidated vendor bills (UPS weekly, utilities, ad spend) cover MANY jobs, so they have no single job by design — they belong to a PERIOD. Holly's ruling 2026-07-16, proven on a real UPS invoice. MUST stay ABOVE R-expense: rules match on doc_type OR note keyword, and R-expense's 'shipping invoice' keyword would otherwise steal these.
Job-attributable one-off expense (a single freight charge billed to one job). Job stays optional; use R-period-expense for consolidated bills.
